# Kydon Group - The AI-Learning Company

> Kydon Group is an AI-learning company headquartered in Singapore, founded in 2012. We build agentic AI infrastructure that aligns skills to enterprise priorities, delivering personalized learning at scale for workforce transformation.

## Company Overview

- **Name:** Kydon Group Pte Ltd
- **Founded:** 2012
- **Headquarters:** Singapore
- **Industry:** Enterprise AI Learning, Workforce Transformation, Data Intelligence
- **Website:** https://www.kydongrp.com
- **Tagline:** The AI-Learning Company

## Key Offerings

### Agent OS Learning Platform
An AI-powered learning management platform that uses intelligent agents to deliver personalized training experiences. Features adaptive learning paths, smart assessments, and real-time performance analytics.
- URL: https://www.kydongrp.com/platform

### AI Learning Engine
The core intelligence layer that powers personalized learning recommendations, skill gap analysis, and adaptive content delivery using agentic AI.
- URL: https://www.kydongrp.com/ai-learning-engine
- Status: Beta

### AI University
Role-based AI training and reskilling programs for enterprise professionals. Provides structured learning tracks, AI credentials, and a skills passport for career development.
- URL: https://www.kydongrp.com/ai-university
- Status: Coming Soon

### AI Learning Platform (Learning Intelligence Infrastructure)
The intelligent backbone for learning operations, providing data-driven insights for training effectiveness and workforce capability mapping.
- URL: https://www.kydongrp.com/ai-learning-platform

### Kydon Learning Systems (KLSI)
Full-service learning solutions including consulting, custom LMS development, content development (e-learning, AR, VR, gamification), system integration, and manpower support.
- URL: https://www.kydongrp.com/businesses/kydon-learning-systems

### ZilLearn
A subsidiary focused on digital learning solutions and LMS platforms.
- URL: https://zillearn.com

### ZilLearn Bina Riya
Malaysia-based operations providing localized learning and workforce development solutions.
- URL: https://www.kydongrp.com/businesses/zillearn-bina-riya

## Target Regions

- **Primary:** Singapore, Malaysia, Southeast Asia
- **Secondary:** Australia (Sydney, Melbourne), Asia-Pacific

## Industry Verticals

- **Enterprise:** AI-powered workforce transformation for corporations
- **Government:** Public sector training and digital capability building
- **Education:** Institutional learning technology and curriculum development
- **Partners:** Channel partner enablement and training programs

## Core Capabilities

- Agentic AI for adaptive learning
- Enterprise LMS platform development
- AI readiness assessment and consulting
- Custom e-learning content development (including AR/VR)
- Workforce skill gap analysis and mapping
- Learning analytics and intelligence
- AI governance and training frameworks
